title: Fix Aarti Section Error — Aartis Not Displaying

requirements.summary: Fix the Aarti section so that all aartis from static data are correctly loaded and displayed as cards without error on all devices
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the Aarti section does not display any error message.
All aarti entries from staticData.ts are rendered as AartiCard components on the page.
The fix works on all devices and browsers.
Clicking an aarti card navigates to the correct AartiDetail page.
No console errors related to aarti data loading or rendering.

file_operations.description: Fix the Aarti page component to correctly import and render all aarti entries from frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts. Ensure the aartis array is properly mapped to AartiCard components with correct props (name, hindiText, deity, gradient). Add error boundary handling to prevent crashes. Verify that the navigation links to /aarti/:id routes are correctly formed using the aarti keys from staticData. Test that the component renders without errors on mount and displays all available aartis as clickable cards.

Review and ensure the AartiCard component correctly receives and displays all required props (name, hindiText preview, deity tag, emoji icon). Verify the component handles missing or undefined props gracefully without throwing errors. Ensure the onClick navigation to the AartiDetail route works correctly. Add prop validation or default values where appropriate to prevent rendering errors.

requirements.summary: Add a graceful empty state UI to the Aarti section showing a friendly Hindi message when no aarti data is available
acceptanceCriteria: If no aarti data is available, a friendly message is shown instead of an error.
The empty state does not crash the app or show a raw error.

file_operations.description: Add an empty state UI that displays when the aartis array is empty or undefined. Show a friendly Hindi message such as 'कोई आरती उपलब्ध नहीं है' (No aartis available) with an appropriate icon or illustration. Ensure this empty state does not trigger any console errors and provides a clean user experience. Style the empty state consistently with the app's Hindu devotional theme using saffron/gold colors.
